title: 第三章斩妖
slug: 开局阴阳宗从反杀师姐开始斩妖除魔
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

下一秒，他的瞳孔猛然骤缩，眼里的恐惧已经掩藏不住了。

他的手微微颤抖，但丝毫没有察觉。

因为他的瞳孔里，已经满是那只狼妖的样子。

尖锐的獠牙上流下丝丝唾液，扑面而来的热息直直打在张守安脸上。

血腥味伴随着一股恶臭传入张守安鼻腔，使他一阵反胃。

但张守安强压心神，在对方有所动作之前，已经撤步拉开距离。

借着这点空隙，他终于看清了那只狼妖的全貌。

它嘴角流淌着大量鲜血，鼻间的皮毛早已被染红。

看起来有些狼狈，可能是伤势所致。

但张守安知道，那不是它的血，他一瞥，赫然见到一旁土地上开膛破肚的尸体。

那已经不成人样，整个尸体都被分成了七八块，撕裂处不算整齐，显然是暴力撕咬所致。

这个畜生……张守安暗骂一句，那只狼竟然几步又冲到了张守安面前。

张守安“啧”了一声，抽剑出鞘，身体完全凭借本能自动，出剑直刺狼妖的瞳孔。

越来越近，越来越近。

可谁知狼妖扭头一转，竟一爪拍在长剑身上。

“呲”长剑与它尖锐的指甲相撞，发出一道刺耳的声音。

而剑身也因此偏离了半寸，擦着狼妖的耳朵划过，留下一撮黑毛。

而狼妖得以直冲张守安面门，张开巨嘴，眼看就要咬了上去。

张守安倒是没有多么慌张，顺势泄劲，沉肩，凭借基础剑法带给身体的本能，回身又是一剑。

再次相撞，再次持平，看似两人没分胜负，但是张守安却是发现了胜利的契机。

他低头一看，就看见了对方躯干上的伤口。

趁你病，要你命。

张守安眉目一冷，落地稳住身形，借着对方还没落地的惯性，手中剑光一闪。

下一秒那柄剑就重重插入狼妖腹部的伤口。

狼妖惨叫一声，挥舞着爪子试图逼退正在攻击的张守安。

只不过，张守安却是不顾一切般的向前突进，用尽全身力气，只求手中的剑再深入几分。

他咬紧牙关，额头青筋暴起，身上已经多了许多伤口，渗出嫣红，污染了白衣。

只不过他却是不管不顾，手中长剑猛然一拧，挖出大片血肉。

原本结痂的伤口瞬间喷涌出大片鲜血，染红了它身上的皮毛，也浸染了大片土地。

破碎的器官伴随血液流出，摔落在地上，看起来颇为恶心。

狼妖惨叫不断，爪子在地上刨出了几条深沟，不久就失去了呼吸。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The next second, his pupils suddenly shrank, and the fear in his eyes could no longer be hidden.

His hands trembled slightly, but he didn't notice it at all.

Because his pupils were already filled with the look of that wolf demon.

A trace of saliva dripped from the sharp fangs, and the hot breath hit Zhang Shou'an's face.

The smell of blood and a foul stench entered Zhang Shou'an's nose, making him feel nauseous.

But Zhang Shou'an suppressed his concentration and retreated to distance himself before the opponent made any move.

Taking advantage of this gap, he finally got a clear view of the wolf demon.

There was a lot of blood flowing from the corners of its mouth, and the fur between its nose had already been dyed red.

He looked a little embarrassed, possibly due to injuries.

But Zhang Shou'an knew that it was not its blood. He glanced at it and saw the disemboweled corpse on the ground beside him.

It was no longer human-like, and the whole body was divided into seven or eight pieces. The tears were not neat, and it was obviously caused by violent bites.

This beast... Zhang Shou'an cursed secretly, and the wolf unexpectedly rushed in front of Zhang Shou'an in a few steps.

Zhang Shou'an let out a "tsk" sound, drew his sword out of its sheath, his body automatically relied on instinct, and thrust the sword straight into the wolf demon's pupil.

Getting closer, getting closer.

But who would have expected that the wolf demon turned its head and slapped the sword with one claw.

"呲" The long sword collided with its sharp nails, making a harsh sound.

As a result, the blade of the sword deviated by half an inch, grazing the wolf demon's ear and leaving a tuft of black hair.

The wolf demon was able to rush straight to Zhang Shou'an's door, opened its huge mouth, and was about to bite him.

Zhang Shou'an was not too panicked. He took advantage of the situation to release his energy, slumped his shoulders, and relied on the instinct brought to his body by basic swordsmanship to turn around and strike again.

They collided again and were tied again. It seemed that there was no winner between the two, but Zhang Shou'an found an opportunity for victory.

He looked down and saw the wounds on the other party's torso.

While you are sick, I will kill you.

Zhang Shouan's eyebrows were cold, he landed on the ground and stabilized his figure. Taking advantage of the opponent's inertia before he landed, the sword in his hand flashed.

The next second the sword was heavily inserted into the wound on the wolf demon's abdomen.

The wolf demon screamed and waved its claws in an attempt to drive away the attacking Zhang Shou'an.

However, Zhang Shouan rushed forward desperately, using all his strength, just to get the sword in his hand to go deeper.

He gritted his teeth, veins popped out on his forehead, and there were already many wounds on his body, which oozed red and stained his white clothes.

But he didn't care. He twisted the long sword in his hand suddenly and dug out a large piece of flesh and blood.

The originally scabbed wound instantly spurted out a large amount of blood, dyeing the fur on its body red and soaking a large area of ​​land.

The broken organs fell to the ground with blood flowing out, looking quite disgusting.

The wolf demon kept screaming, its claws dug several deep grooves on the ground, and soon it lost its breath.
